ja.title: PK/PD・PBPK・QSPは何が違うのか
ja.summary: PK/PD、PBPK、QSPの定義と重なりを、問い・モデル構造・個人差の三つの観点から整理する。模式図と架空のPK/PD計算例を使い、用途に応じた使い分けと評価を考える。

english.title: How do PK/PD, PBPK and QSP differ?
english.summary: A Japanese introduction comparing PK/PD, PBPK and QSP without treating them as a complexity ladder. Original diagrams and a hypothetical PK/PD simulation illustrate connected modelling approaches, population variability and evaluation for a defined purpose. No real-drug prediction is claimed.
